description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of the hidden state across different layers, comparing three distinct representations. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate", an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate", and a green solid line for the "hidden state". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively stable around 0.2 until layer 10, and then increases to 0.7 at layer 18, before rising sharply to 4.5 at layer 23. The orange dotted line and the green solid line both remain close to 0 across all layers, with values ranging from 0 to 0.1.
